PNG is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2013 to 2015.

What it was for: [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1) and [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1).

Most recently: [big-png](@/work/big-png.md): A compression curiosity: an enormous PNG in a tiny file; [social-icons](@/work/social-icons.md): Social Networks icons from Devise Example.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses PNG: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links PNG to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
